messages:
Priya (People Ops): Hey team — prepping a consolidated Day 1 checklist for new managers starting next Tue. Want to make sure the 30/60/90 template and immediate ops handoffs are covered. Quick Qs:

Sam (Eng Manager): Sounds good. Can you share the short agenda? I'll need to add calendar invites for Dir and IC intros.

Priya (People Ops): Here's the draft Day 1 agenda:
```
0900 - Welcome + paperwork (Maya)
1000 - Laptop & access provisioning (Carlos)
1030 - Team intros + org chart (Sam)
1130 - Role expectations + KPIs (manager's skip-level)
1200 - Lunch with buddy
1400 - Systems walkthrough (billing, infra, dashboards)
1500 - One-on-one planning (30/60/90)
1600 - EOD sync with People Ops
```

Maya (HR): Note — benefits enrollment link needs to be in the calendar invite and SSO guide pinned.

Carlos (IT): FYI, new managers often hit blocked GSuite permissions and SSO SCIM sync. I'll pre-provision laptop image and add to the IT ticket: #IT-IMAGING-{{ticket}}

Sam (Eng Manager): For the 30/60/90 template, could we standardize metrics? I like: Week 1 goals, 30d measurable outcomes, 60d integration milestones, 90d delivery target + risks.

Ezra (People Ops): Agreed. I made a minimal template to keep short and measurable — pasted below.

Ezra (People Ops): ```
30/60/90 TEMPLATE (high level):
- 30d: Team relationships, access, 1 small deliverable (what/why/success metric)
- 60d: Ownership over a key area, 1 cross-team project (milestones)
- 90d: Independent delivery & stakeholder feedback loop (measure: e.g., reduced cycle time)
```

Priya (People Ops): Great. Two ops items: 1) we need a clear escape hatch for their first week if blocked on access (who to ping). 2) Assign a buddy for shadowing.

Carlos (IT): Escape hatch = @Carlos + @IT-Oncall + create short Zoom triage. I'll include a "if blocked" note in the invite with escalation tags.

Maya (HR): I'll handle the buddy assignment and payroll forms. Priya, can you confirm who signs off the 30/60/90? Manager's manager or direct skip-level?

Priya (People Ops): Manager's manager should sign off on high-level milestones; direct skip-level to review weekly during first month.

Sam (Eng Manager): One more ask — can we include a 1-pager on alerting responsibilities (oncall expectations, paging, runbook owners)? New managers ask this a lot.

Ezra (People Ops): I'll add a "Quick Ops" annex to the onboarding packet with pointers to runbooks and ownership matrix.

Onboarding Bot: Reminder scheduled: send Day 0 checklist email 48h before start; send Day 1 agenda 24h before.

Priya (People Ops): Thanks everyone. I'll update the calendar template and post the final checklist here by EOD tomorrow. If anyone has sample 30/60/90 notes from prior hires, drop them here :slightly_smiling_face:

Sam (Eng Manager): Dropping one example: First 30d: complete codebase walkthrough + ship small bugfix. 60d: own a feature. 90d: lead release. I'll DM you the doc.

Maya (HR): Ping me if benefits flow needs rewording. Also confirm that the new manager gets manager-level training slot in week 2.

Priya (People Ops): Noted — week 2 manager training slot tentatively booked. Last msg: assigning owners: Carlos = access, Maya = paperwork + buddy, Sam = team intros, Ezra = 30/60/90 template + quick ops annex.

Carlos (IT): I'll pre-seed SSO invites today.

Ezra (People Ops): Will assemble final packet and share link.

Priya (People Ops): Closing thread — will post updated checklist: https://redwoodinc.slack.com/archives/people-ops/p-manager-onboard-day1 :party_parrot:
